title: Publisher usage & quota patterns — listing copy + acceptance notes (WIP)
body:
Purpose:

This is a working note to capture recommended usage/quota patterns, SKU mapping heuristics, and marketplace UI copy fragments for partner listings that use usage-based or hybrid billing. Focus is practical: make it easy for engineers/product to map runtime telemetry to marketplace entitlements and for marketing to have concise, compliance-safe copy.

Context / problem we solve:
- Partners are confused about how to present token/compute quotas in tiles and trial badges.
- Product and billing teams need a repeatable mapping from runtime signals (tokens, embeddings units, concurrent streams) -> marketplace SKUs and quota enforcement points.
- UX needs clear microcopy for "quota exceeded" states that avoids false support escalations.

Audience:
- Go-to-market owners submitting listing assets
- Partner engineers wiring metering hooks
- Billing/finance reviewers validating SKU mapping

High-level guidance (one liner):
- Surface simple tiers (Starter / Scale / Enterprise) on the tile, but use the details page to show tokens/embeddings specifics. Always show trial entitlements and how overages are handled.

SKU & Quota patterns (recommended canonical patterns):
1) Simple monthly usage (starter-friendly):
   - SKU name: publisher-usage-monthly-starter
   - Meter: tokens/month (integer)
   - Example tiers in copy: Starter — 2M tokens / month included; $X per additional 100k tokens
   - When to use: single-API products, low integration complexity

2) Dual-metric hybrid: calls + tokens
   - SKU: publisher-hybrid-growth
   - Meters: api_calls/month (count), tokens/month (integer)
   - Why: protects against many tiny calls; easier analytics for merchants

3) Concurrency and throughput SKU (enterprise):
   - SKU: publisher-concurrency-enterprise
   - Meter: concurrent-streams (gauge), tokens/minute (rate)
   - When to use: streaming, low-latency SLAs, reserved capacity patterns

4) Embedding-heavy SKU (vector workloads):
   - SKU: publisher-embeddings-credits
   - Meter: embedding-units (per-1000 vectors)

Metering implementation notes for engineers:
- Primary signal MUST be emitted to billing bridge: {"meter_id": <sku>, "quantity": <int>, "timestamp": <iso>} — (implementation detail referenced in linked_artifacts).
- Provide a periodic summarization (daily aggregate) to avoid noisy line items.
- Include dimension labels: region, customer_id, plan_id. These map to marketplace tenant ids.
- Add a fallback lightweight counter if streaming SDK disconnects (to avoid silent consumption loss).

User-facing copy snippets (tile / short blurbs) — aim for 1–2 short lines:
- Tile headline (short): "Fast, predictable LLM inference — pay for what you use"
- One-line subhead for tokens SKU: "Includes 2M tokens/month; pay per extra 100k tokens"
- Trial badge: "30-day trial: 500k tokens included"
- Long description opening paragraph (200–300 char):
  "Redwood partner integration: low-latency text and embedding inference with flexible usage pricing. Start with a trial including 500k tokens, then choose Starter, Scale, or Enterprise tiers. Metering integrates with marketplace billing and supports per-token and per-embedding metering."

Microcopy for quota states (these are subtle; avoid blaming the merchant):
- Quota hit (in-app UI and marketplace banner):
  "You’ve reached your monthly included usage. To continue, upgrade your plan or purchase additional tokens. Need help? Contact support or enable auto-topup in billing settings."
- Temporary rate limit (short-term):
  "High traffic detected — requests temporarily rate limited. Requests will resume shortly. If you need sustained throughput, consider the Scale tier or request a dedicated capacity trial."
- Overages post-trial (email + banner):
  Subject line suggestion: "Action required: Trial usage exceeded — next steps to keep running"
  Banner: "Your trial usage exceeded included limits. To avoid disruption, upgrade or enable auto-charge for overages."

Acceptance checklist for partner listing submission (GTM reviewer + eng):
- [ ] SKU(s) defined and named using canonical prefix 'publisher-'
- [ ] Meter definitions documented (type, unit, aggregation window)
- [ ] Billing bridge emits daily aggregates to marketplace connector (sample payload attached in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Trial entitlements documented and wired to trial SKUs
- [ ] Quota enforcement points implemented with graceful fallsbacks (UI banner, API 429 with Retry-After header)
- [ ] Copy snippets included in listing package (tile headline, subhead, long description, trial badge, quota microcopy)
- [ ] Security & privacy disclosure for data sent to embeddings endpoints (if applicable)
- [ ] Telemetry keys documented (metrics names and labels) for post-launch validation
- [ ] Demo flow + smoke test plan attached (link to GH action)

Telemetry / Validation keys (ops):
- metric.tokens.consumed.daily (labels: customer_id, plan_id, region)
- metric.embeddings.units.daily
- metric.api.calls.429.rate
- trace.quota.enforcement.event (for sampling enforcement decisions)

Sample pricing table (for copy; numbers are placeholders):
- Starter: includes 2,000,000 tokens / month — $0.00 trial — $19/mo baseline, $0.10 per 100k tokens overage
- Growth: includes 10,000,000 tokens / month — $99/mo baseline, $0.08 per 100k tokens overage
- Enterprise: custom pricing — includes SLA, dedicated capacity options, per-minute rate quotas

Edge cases / open questions (to resolve before submission):
- Q1: Do we allow negative balancing (debt) for small partners and invoice monthly? (Finance: decision needed)
- Q2: How are refunds handled for mis-metered days? (Billing ops: playbook)
- Q3: Embeddings rounding granularity — per 1k vectors or per vector? (Engineering: recommend per-1k for economic predictability)
- Q4: Auto-topup UX — where does it show in marketplace console? (GTM: screenshot required)

Compliance & security callouts:
- If listing public tile references PII handling, include a short paragraph: "We do not store customer input beyond transient caches used for inference and retention is configurable via private deployment settings." (Security review required)
- KMS/HSM usage for keys in private deployments must be called out in the listing extras section.

Smoke test plan (very short):
1) Create test tenant (marketplace sandbox)
2) Exercise trial token allotment; confirm billing connector receives daily aggregate and marketplace records trial consumption
3) Simulate overage and verify UI banner + 429+Retry-After returned by API and email sent
4) Validate telemetry metrics under load and confirm labels map to marketplace tenant id

Copy examples for marketplace FAQ (short Q/A):
- Q: What is a token?
  A: A token is a unit of text processed by the model. 100 tokens ~ 75 words (approx.).
- Q: Can I get an invoice?
  A: Yes — invoice billing is available for annual contracts. Contact sales for setup.

Notes to self / next steps:
- Pull real pricing examples from finance (JIRA: FIN-1158) and replace placeholder numbers.
- Ask engineering to add 'trace.quota.enforcement.event' to sampling (Devon).
- Finalize trial badge copy with marketing and legal.

Slack threads / references:
- Slack: #marketplace-onboarding thread id: mp-onboard-2025-11
- Confluence mock: MP-usage-patterns-v1

Unresolved phrasing candidates (for legal review):
- "Pay per token" vs "Usage-based billing" (legal prefers second, marketing prefers first)
- "Includes" vs "Allocated" when describing monthly entitlements (use "allocated" on legal copy)

----
Workshop notes (raw, rough):
- Marta: prefer embedding credits expressed as 'per 1k' units to make math easier for customers
- Jordan: wants a short API error code mapping doc for support — map 429 to "QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
- Aisha: keep tile copy <70 characters to avoid truncation in some marketplaces

End of doc — iterative living artifact.
